Khushi patni hai.
Azadi suraj hai.
Khushi wahi chhodna hai jo tum sochte ho.
Khushi se zyada anand jeevan ka antim lakshya hai, kyunki anand dard ke beech bhi ho sakta hai.
Apni freedom pane ke liye apna rasta bhool jao.
Unke shukraguzar ho jo hamein khush rakhte hain; woh hamari rooh ko khilate hain.
Azadi kabhi muft nahi hoti.
Ek azaad panchhi hawa ki peeth par koodta hai.
Khushi atma hai.
Azadi ek shaant mann hai.
Map chhodho, apne dil ki dhadkan follow karo.
Azaadi apna naseeb chunne ki shakti hai.
Joy yeh ehsas hai ki zindagi acchi hai.
Freedom apni terms par life jeena hai.
Aazadi koi manzil nahi; astitva ki ek aadharbhut sachai hai.
Light travel karo, deep jiyo, free feel karo.
Azaadi theek karne wali hai.
Joy ridge par storm se pehle ki khamoshi hai.
Anand ka peecha nahi kiya ja sakta, woh khud aa jata hai.
Khushi dil ka khamosh sangeet hai.
Khushi andar ki shanti hai.

Azadi tum khud bano hai.
Khushi shaant dimaag ki meethi khushboo hai.
Joy ek bhare hue dil ka uchhaal hai.
